displayName: Strength Save: cost anomaly - Firestore writes and deletes per hour

documentation.content: Firestore writes or deletes in the last hour exceeded 500. Baseline 2026-08-31..09-30: writes median 3/h, p95 26/h, p99 40/h, max 78/h; deletes max 37/h. Typical cause: a sync/retry loop on a client, a trigger writing the document it listens to, or a runaway repair/cleanup job. Check Firestore Usage + Cloud Logging, then docs/COST-GUARDS.md.
